title: Marcos pardons Mary Jane Veloso
summary: 'Pinirmahan ko na. Pinirmahan ko na 'yong pardon niya kahapon,' Marcos says

blocks.text: TEARS OF JOY. Mary Jane Veloso is emotional during a video call with her family before a press conference, prior to her repatriation to the Philippines, at the Soekarno-Hatta International Airport in Jakarta, Indonesia, December 17, 2024.
'Pinirmahan ko na. Pinirmahan ko na 'yong pardon niya kahapon,' Marcos says
MANILA, Philippines – President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. has pardoned former overseas Filipino worker (OFW) Mary Jane Veloso, paving the way for the embattled worker’s freedom after over 15 years.
Marcos confirmed on Friday, September 25, that he has pardoned Veloso.
“Pinirmahan ko na. Pinirmahan ko na ‘yong pardon niya kahapon (I signed it already. I signed her pardon yesterday),” the President said in a chance interview. – Rappler.com
